sp_widget.css:
<!-- Font Awesome for icons -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/5.15.4/css/all.min.css">

<style>
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    background: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1581091870622-7a4bd17f99a5') no-repeat center center/cover;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .refund-home-container {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); /* Dark overlay */
    padding: 40px 20px;
    min-height: 100vh;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .refund-hero-banner h1 {
    font-size: 3em;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #ffcc00;
  }

  .refund-hero-banner p {
    font-size: 1.2em;
    color: #f0f0f0;
  }

  .refund-cards {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 30px;
    margin-top: 40px;
  }

  .refund-card {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    padding: 25px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    width: 280px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  }

  .refund-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  }

  .refund-card i {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    color: #ffcc00;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }

  .refund-card h2 {
    font-size: 1.5em;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  .refund-card p {
    font-size: 0.95em;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    color: #e0e0e0;
  }

  .refund-card button {
    background-color: #ffcc00;
    color: #000;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 5px;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: 0.3s;
  }

  .refund-card button:hover {
    background-color: #e6b800;
  }

  .refund-process {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: 60px;
    gap: 40px;
  }

  .refund-step {
    text-align: center;
  }

  .refund-step i {
    font-size: 2em;
    color: #00ffff;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .refund-step p {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  .process-line {
    width: 60px;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: #00ffff;
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .refund-cards {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .refund-process {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .process-line {
      width: 3px;
      height: 40px;
    }
  }
</style>
